phoneNumber.description: This is the phone number that the message is associated with.

type.description: This is the type of the message. "transfer-update" is sent whenever a transfer happens.

destination.description: This is the destination of the transfer.

timestamp.description: This is the timestamp of the message.

call.description: This is the call that the message is associated with.

customer.description: This is the customer that the message is associated with.

assistant.description: This is the assistant that the message is associated with.

toAssistant.description: This is the assistant that the call is being transferred to. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".

fromAssistant.description: This is the assistant that the call is being transferred from. This is only sent if `destination.type` is "assistant".

toStepRecord.description: This is the step that the conversation moved to.

fromStepRecord.description: This is the step that the conversation moved from. =
